notes: v5.3 field-fix release: (1) Login with Google no longer shows the Windows error "Windows cannot find 'Aura'" — all panel launches are quoted correctly, and the panel only says the terminal opened when it really did. (2) The AI planner no longer fails behind a vague 'internal error': connection failures say so plainly, the panel automatically tries your other connected account/provider when one route fails, and Settings -> Diagnostics keeps the exact last AI error (with a Copy button). (3) Font Finder reads the screenshot correctly at pick time. (4) Text animations can't turn text black/invisible any more: Reverse Rise rests fully visible, a new animation replaces the old one instead of stacking, an animation that can't be built cleanly is removed again, and Text Animations has a Remove Aura animation button. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
